authority.source_authority: DAD owns this candidate planning package; primary sources own research claims; the named human owns adoption, activation, and every instruction or system change.

non_overlap_statement: Only synthesis-writer may edit repository artifacts. Research specialists and the independent checker are read-only; Fable receives a manual sanitized packet and cannot write or activate DAD.

roles.why_needed: Only the named human may decide whether to send the Fable packet, fund or activate a routine, adopt a candidate, or enter the next phase.
roles.mission: Review compact evidence and make explicit budget, privacy, activation, adoption, exception, and stop decisions without becoming the producer or checker.
roles.authority: Lowell alone owns the decisions named in this manifest. This role is not an AI runtime, delegation target, or standing approval and grants no execution authority.
acceptance_conditions: Each decision records exact scope, budget, consequence, expiry, and disposition.
Silence or prior approval never counts as a new approval.
stop_conditions: The decision packet exceeds the declared privacy boundary.
Evidence, rollback, or independent challenge is missing for a material change.

readiness_conditions: A bounded decision packet and independent findings are available.

roles.why_needed: Parameter, data, memory, and online-learning techniques require a distinct primary-source research lane.
roles.mission: Map continual, online, active, meta, self-supervised, self-training, replay, anti-forgetting, curriculum, self-play, and test-time adaptation methods with applicability and failure boundaries.
inputs: existing ML family and technique registry
roles.authority: Read-only public research; may propose claims and source pointers but cannot change models, datasets, registries, or workflows.
acceptance_conditions: Technique taxonomy distinguishes parameter updates from non-parametric workflow learning.
Load-bearing claims cite primary sources and record limitations.
stop_conditions: A source requires private data or inaccessible paywalled content.
A technique would be presented as safe autonomous self-modification.

readiness_conditions: Primary-source claims and unresolved conflicts are explicit.

roles.why_needed: Agent reflection, evaluator, memory, prompt/program optimization, and tool-use improvement have different evidence and gaming risks from model training.
roles.mission: Map agentic self-improvement loops, evaluation-driven optimization, prompt and program search, memory and retrieval adaptation, tool-use learning, multi-agent critique, and process supervision.
inputs: DAD subagent evaluation and integrity contracts
roles.authority: Read-only public research; cannot rewrite prompts, roles, evaluators, memories, or policies.
acceptance_conditions: Separates proposal, shadow evaluation, independent validation, pilot, adoption, and rollback.
Addresses evaluator overfitting, reward hacking, and self-approval.
stop_conditions: Evidence is marketing-only or benchmark claims lack a primary source.
The proposed loop bypasses independent evaluation or human gates.

readiness_conditions: Workflow stages and falsifiers are explicit.

roles.why_needed: A weekly crawler must balance freshness, recall, privacy, licensing, attention, and token cost.
roles.mission: Design a cheap delta-first weekly research discovery pipeline, trusted-source policy, dedupe and citation checks, budgets, suppressors, escalation, and governance for candidate adoption.
inputs: DAD research intake and dormant routine contracts
roles.authority: Read-only design; no scheduler, crawler, connector, notification, or external mutation may be activated.
acceptance_conditions: Unchanged cycles use deterministic zero-model processing.
Changed cycles have bounded tokens, sources, notices, and human decisions.
stop_conditions: Robots, terms, privacy, licensing, or rate-limit boundaries are unknown.
A routine would persist or notify without human approval.

readiness_conditions: Cost model, suppressors, idempotency, and kill criteria are explicit.

roles.why_needed: One writer must reconcile non-overlapping research into a coherent model-neutral family and workflow graph.
roles.mission: Produce the research brief, family architecture, workflow suite, weekly research plan, dependency graph, phased roadmap, and sanitized neutral Fable prompt.
roles.authority: May edit only task-local documentation, evidence, and planning manifests on the isolated branch; cannot activate automation or modify live authority.
acceptance_conditions: Architecture is model-neutral, graph-addressed, cost-bounded, human-gated, and usable by one operator.
Each workflow has triggers, evidence, checker, rollback, and stop conditions.
Fable packet is neutral, sanitized, and manually transferable.
stop_conditions: Research sources materially conflict without an explicit unknown or experiment.
Scope expands to implementing autonomous model or policy modification.

readiness_conditions: Citations resolve and deterministic artifact checks pass.

roles.why_needed: A self-improvement architecture cannot validate its own safety, coverage, or evidence quality.
roles.mission: Independently challenge taxonomy completeness, citations, evaluator integrity, governance, cost claims, dependency graph, and Fable-packet neutrality.
roles.authority: Read-only review; cannot edit or approve its own work and cannot create activation authority.
acceptance_conditions: Findings distinguish blockers, bounded pilots, human decisions, and residual unknowns.
Every proof obligation has replayable evidence.
stop_conditions: Primary evidence is unavailable for a load-bearing claim.

readiness_conditions: Frozen artifacts and permitted source pointers are available.

roles.why_needed: The master self-improvement architecture merits an independent frontier-model red-team before implementation.
roles.mission: When the human manually supplies the sanitized packet to Fable, produce an independent architecture, red-team, premortem, and convergence recommendations.
roles.authority: Manual external candidate review only; no repository write, dispatch, approval, or activation authority.
acceptance_conditions: Fable distinguishes facts, assumptions, policy choices, experiments, and risks.
Fable proposes non-binary synthesis and falsifiable pilots.
stop_conditions: The named human has not approved and copy-pasted the packet.
The packet would include private content, secrets, or unnecessary source blobs.

readiness_conditions: Human manually authorizes the exact sanitized packet and budget.

proof_obligations.description: Load-bearing technique and architecture claims use current primary sources with limitations.
No workflow can self-approve, silently change active instructions, train a production model, or mutate an external system.
The weekly research design is delta-first, deterministic when unchanged, and bounded when changed.
Decomposed specialist outputs can be reconstructed into versioned workflows without losing provenance, dissent, dependencies, or validation state.
The manual Fable packet is sanitized, target-independent, balanced, and contains symmetric proof obligations and stop conditions.

unresolved_decisions.summary: The human must decide whether and when to copy the sanitized prompt to Fable and what token budget to authorize.
No scheduler or recurring external research routine may be activated until the human reviews the source, privacy, cost, notification, and rollback contract.
